title: Little Erhei Gets Married
synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.

fullText.simplified:
最后怎么样了

    区长让人去调查大南小南在村里做过的事情。刚开始，大家都因为害怕大南小南，不敢说。后来，有个小伙子站了出来，说：“你们不说，我说！”他把大南小南怎么打他，怎么要了他们家的地，要了他们家的钱等，全部都说了。
    有了这个小伙子开头，大家不再害怕了。被大南小南打的人太多了，大家一直说，从中午一直说到了太阳下山，还没有说完。
    区里来的人把大家说的这些都记了下来，然后把大南小南抓起来了。
    高老汉和三花也有了变化：
    三花那天在区里被那么多人看了半天，说了半天，觉得很不好意思。回到家后，她看了一下自己，觉得自己真的打扮得太不像话了；她又想到自己的女儿快要跟人结婚了，自己还想着打扮，想着和小伙子玩儿，真的太不应该了。于是，她决定把自己的打扮从头到脚换一下，让自己看起来像个当妈的人，还把她三十年来打扮成天神时用的那朵大红花收起来了。
    高老汉那天从区里回来，又向妻子说起小二黑和多喜的生日不适合结婚，他妻子说：“把你的算命书收起来吧！你不是说二黑这次要出大事吗？结果呢？你呀，做什么事都要算一下，结果呢？你不记得‘不适合种地’的笑话了吗？我看多喜很不错，就让她和我们二黑结婚吧！”高老汉看到连自己的妻子都不信自己的算命了，也不再好意思把算命书拿出来给别人算命了。
    多喜和小二黑回到家后，看到自己的爸爸妈妈都同意让他们结婚了，很高兴。两家人准备了一下，很快，多喜和小二黑就结婚了。村里的人们都说，他们是村里第一对好夫妻！
fullText.traditional:
最後怎麼樣了

    區長讓人去調查大南小南在村裡做過的事情。剛開始，大家都因為害怕大南小南，不敢說。後來，有個小伙子站了出來，說：“你們不說，我說！”他把大南小南怎麼打他，怎麼要了他們家的地，要了他們家的錢等，全部都說了。
    有了這個小伙子開頭，大家不再害怕了。被大南小南打的人太多了，大家一直說，從中午一直說到了太陽下山，還沒有說完。
    區裡來的人把大家說的這些都記了下來，然後把大南小南抓起來了。
    高老漢和三花也有了變化：
    三花那天在區裡被那麼多人看了半天，說了半天，覺得很不好意思。回到家後，她看了一下自己，覺得自己真的打扮得太不像話了；她又想到自己的女兒快要跟人結婚了，自己還想著打扮，想著和小伙子玩兒，真的太不應該了。於是，她決定把自己的打扮從頭到腳換一下，讓自己看起來像個當媽的人，還把她三十年來打扮成天神時用的那朵大紅花收起來了。
    高老漢那天從區裡回來，又向妻子說起小二黑和多喜的生日不適合結婚，他妻子說：“把你的算命書收起來吧！你不是說二黑這次要出大事嗎？結果呢？你呀，做什麼事都要算一下，結果呢？你不記得‘不適合種地’的笑話了嗎？我看多喜很不錯，就讓她和我們二黑結婚吧！”高老漢看到連自己的妻子都不信自己的算命了，也不再好意思把算命書拿出來給別人算命了。
    多喜和小二黑回到家後，看到自己的爸爸媽媽都同意讓他們結婚了，很高興。兩家人準備了一下，很快，多喜和小二黑就結婚了。村裡的人們都說，他們是村裡第一對好夫妻！

sentences.simplified: 区长让人去调查大南小南在村里做过的事情。
sentences.traditional: 區長讓人去調查大南小南在村裡做過的事情。
sentences.pinyin: qū zhǎng ràng rén qù diào chá dà nán xiǎo nán zài cūn lǐ zuò guò de shì qing
sentences.english: The district chief had people investigate what Big Nan and Little Nan did in the village.

sentences.simplified: 刚开始，大家都因为害怕大南小南，不敢说。
sentences.traditional: 剛開始，大家都因為害怕大南小南，不敢說。
sentences.pinyin: gāng kāi shǐ dà jiā dōu yīn wèi hài pà dà nán xiǎo nán bù gǎn shuō
sentences.english: At first, because everyone was scared of Big Nan and Little Nan, no one dared speak up.

sentences.simplified: 后来，有个小伙子站了出来，说：“你们不说，我说！”
sentences.traditional: 後來，有個小伙子站了出來，說：“你們不說，我說！”
sentences.pinyin: hòu lái yǒu ge xiǎo huǒ zi zhàn le chū lái shuō nǐ men bù shuō wǒ shuō
sentences.english: Later, a young guy stood up and said, “If no one will speak, I’ll speak!”

sentences.simplified: 他把大南小南怎么打他，怎么要了他们家的地，要了他们家的钱等，全部都说了。
sentences.traditional: 他把大南小南怎麼打他，怎麼要了他們家的地，要了他們家的錢等，全部都說了。
sentences.pinyin: tā bǎ dà nán xiǎo nán zěn me dǎ tā zěn me yào le tā men jiā de dì yào le tā men jiā de qián děng quán bù dōu shuō le
sentences.english: He told everything … how Big Nan and Little Nan hit him, how they took his family’s land, how they took his family’s money.

sentences.simplified: 有了这个小伙子开头，大家不再害怕了。
sentences.traditional: 有了這個小伙子開頭，大家不再害怕了。
sentences.pinyin: yǒu le zhè ge xiǎo huǒ zi kāi tóu dà jiā bú zài hài pà le
sentences.english: With this young guy taking the lead, no one was afraid anymore.

sentences.simplified: 被大南小南打的人太多了，
sentences.traditional: 被大南小南打的人太多了，
sentences.pinyin: bèi dà nán xiǎo nán dǎ de rén tài duō le
sentences.english: There were too many people who had been hit by Big Nan and Little Nan.

sentences.simplified: 大家一直说，从中午一直说到了太阳下山，还没有说完。
sentences.traditional: 大家一直說，從中午一直說到了太陽下山，還沒有說完。
sentences.pinyin: dà jiā yì zhí shuō cóng zhōng wǔ yì zhí shuō dào le tài yáng xià shān hái méi yǒu shuō wán
sentences.english: Everyone kept talking, from noon until sunset, and they still weren’t finished.

sentences.simplified: 区里来的人把大家说的这些都记了下来，然后把大南小南抓起来了。
sentences.traditional: 區裡來的人把大家說的這些都記了下來，然後把大南小南抓起來了。
sentences.pinyin: qū lǐ lái de rén bǎ dà jiā shuō de zhè xiē dōu jì le xia lai rán hòu bǎ dà nán xiǎo nán zhuā qǐ lai le
sentences.english: The people from the district recorded everything that was said, and then arrested Big Nan and Little Nan.

sentences.simplified: 高老汉和三花也有了变化：
sentences.traditional: 高老漢和三花也有了變化：
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn hé sān huā yě yǒu le biàn huà
sentences.english: Gao Laohan and Sanhua also changed:

sentences.simplified: 三花那天在区里被那么多人看了半天，说了半天，觉得很不好意思。
sentences.traditional: 三花那天在區裡被那麼多人看了半天，說了半天，覺得很不好意思。
sentences.pinyin: sān huā nà tiān zài qū lǐ bèi nà me duō rén kàn le bàn tiān shuō le bàn tiān jué de hěn bù hǎo yì si
sentences.english: Sanhua, after being stared at and talked about in the district for so long, felt very embarrassed.

sentences.simplified: 回到家后，她看了一下自己，觉得自己真的打扮得太不像话了；
sentences.traditional: 回到家後，她看了一下自己，覺得自己真的打扮得太不像話了；
sentences.pinyin: huí dào jiā hòu tā kàn le yí xià zì jǐ jué de zì jǐ zhēn de dǎ ban de tài bú xiàng huà le
sentences.english: After returning home, she took a look at herself, and thought that the way she dressed was too ridiculous.

sentences.simplified: 她又想到自己的女儿快要跟人结婚了，
sentences.traditional: 她又想到自己的女兒快要跟人結婚了，
sentences.pinyin: tā yòu xiǎng dào zì jǐ de nǚ ér kuài yào gēn rén jié hūn le
sentences.english: She then remembered that her daughter was about to get married, ..

sentences.simplified: 自己还想着打扮，想着和小伙子玩儿，
sentences.traditional: 自己還想著打扮，想著和小伙子玩兒，
sentences.pinyin: zì jǐ hái xiǎng zhe dǎ ban xiǎng zhe hé xiǎo huǒ zi wán'r
sentences.english: .. and yet she was thinking about her own appearance and about hanging out with young guys.

sentences.simplified: 真的太不应该了。
sentences.traditional: 真的太不應該了。
sentences.pinyin: zhēn de tài bù yīng gāi le
sentences.english: It really shouldn’t be like that.

sentences.simplified: 于是，她决定把自己的打扮从头到脚换一下，让自己看起来像个当妈的人，
sentences.traditional: 於是，她決定把自己的打扮從頭到腳換一下，讓自己看起來像個當媽的人，
sentences.pinyin: yú shì tā jué dìng bǎ zì jǐ de dǎ ban cóng tóu dào jiǎo huàn yí xià ràng zì jǐ kàn qi lai xiàng ge dāng mā de rén
sentences.english: Hence, she decided to change her appearance from head to toe so that she looked more like someone’s mother.

sentences.simplified: 还把她三十年来打扮成天神时用的那朵大红花收起来了。
sentences.traditional: 還把她三十年來打扮成天神時用的那朵大紅花收起來了。
sentences.pinyin: hái bǎ tā sān shí nián lái dǎ ban chéng tiān shén shí yòng de nà duǒ dà hóng huā shōu qǐ lai le
sentences.english: She even put away the big red flower she had been using for the past thirty years to dress up as a god.

sentences.simplified: 高老汉那天从区里回来，
sentences.traditional: 高老漢那天從區裡回來，
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn nà tiān cóng qū lǐ huí lái
sentences.english: That day Gao Laohan returned from the district, ..

sentences.simplified: 又向妻子说起小二黑和多喜的生日不适合结婚，
sentences.traditional: 又向妻子說起小二黑和多喜的生日不適合結婚，
sentences.pinyin: yòu xiàng qī zi shuō qǐ xiǎo èr hēi hé duō xǐ de shēng rì bú shì hé jié hūn
sentences.english: .. and again began telling his wife how Little Erhei and Duoxi’s birthdays were not suitable for marriage.

sentences.simplified: 他妻子说：“把你的算命书收起来吧！
sentences.traditional: 他妻子說：“把你的算命書收起來吧！
sentences.pinyin: tā qī zi shuō bǎ nǐ de suàn mìng shū shōu qǐ lai ba
sentences.english: His wife said, “Put your fortune-telling book away!

sentences.simplified: 你不是说二黑这次要出大事吗？结果呢？
sentences.traditional: 你不是說二黑這次要出大事嗎？結果呢？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ bú shì shuō èr hēi zhè cì yào chū dà shì ma jié guǒ ne
sentences.english: Didn’t you say that Erhei was going to get in big trouble this time? What happened?

sentences.simplified: 你呀，做什么事都要算一下，结果呢？你不记得‘不适合种地’的笑话了吗？
sentences.traditional: 你呀，做什麼事都要算一下，結果呢？你不記得‘不適合種地’的笑話了嗎？
sentences.pinyin: nǐ ya zuò shén me shì dōu yào suàn yí xià jié guǒ ne nǐ bú jì de bú shì hé zhòng dì de xiào huà le ma
sentences.english: You turn to fortune-telling for every matter, with what outcome? You don’t remember the “not suitable for farming” joke?

sentences.simplified: 我看多喜很不错，就让她和我们二黑结婚吧！”
sentences.traditional: 我看多喜很不錯，就讓她和我們二黑結婚吧！”
sentences.pinyin: wǒ kàn duō xǐ hěn bú cuò jiù ràng tā hé wǒ men èr hēi jié hūn ba
sentences.english: I think Duoxi is great; just let her and our Erhei get married!”

sentences.simplified: 高老汉看到连自己的妻子都不信自己的算命了，
sentences.traditional: 高老漢看到連自己的妻子都不信自己的算命了，
sentences.pinyin: gāo lǎo hàn kàn dào lián zì jǐ de qī zi dōu bú xìn zì jǐ de suàn mìng le
sentences.english: Gao Laohan saw that even his own wife did not believe in his fortune-teling.

sentences.simplified: 也不再好意思把算命书拿出来给别人算命了。
sentences.traditional: 也不再好意思把算命書拿出來給別人算命了。
sentences.pinyin: yě bú zài hǎo yì si bǎ suàn mìng shū ná chū lái gěi bié ren suàn mìng le
sentences.english: After that, he was embarrassed to take out his fortune-telling book and tell fortunes for other people.

sentences.simplified: 多喜和小二黑回到家后，看到自己的爸爸妈妈都同意让他们结婚了，很高兴。
sentences.traditional: 多喜和小二黑回到家後，看到自己的爸爸媽媽都同意讓他們結婚了，很高興。
sentences.pinyin: duō xǐ hé xiǎo èr hēi huí dào jiā hòu kàn dào zì jǐ de bà ba mā ma dōu tóng yì ràng tā men jié hūn le hěn gāo xìng
sentences.english: After Duoxi and Little Erhei came home and saw that their parents all agreed for them to get married, they were very happy.

sentences.simplified: 两家人准备了一下，很快，多喜和小二黑就结婚了。
sentences.traditional: 兩家人準備了一下，很快，多喜和小二黑就結婚了。
sentences.pinyin: liǎng jiā rén zhǔn bèi le yí xià hěn kuài duō xǐ hé xiǎo èr hēi jiù jié hūn le
sentences.english: The two families took some time to prepare, and soon after, Duoxi and Little Erhei were married.

sentences.simplified: 村里的人们都说，他们是村里第一对好夫妻！
sentences.traditional: 村裡的人們都說，他們是村裡第一對好夫妻！
sentences.pinyin: cūn lǐ de rén men dōu shuō tā men shì cūn lǐ dì yī duì hǎo fū qī
sentences.english: Everyone in the village would say that they were the best couple in the village!

raw.synopsis: The story of Little Erhei’s marriage, adapted from Zhao Shuli’s famous short story.
sentence_translations: What Happened in the End?
The district chief had people investigate what Big Nan and Little Nan did in the village.
At first, because everyone was scared of Big Nan and Little Nan, no one dared speak up.
Later, a young guy stood up and said, “If no one will speak, I’ll speak!”
He told everything … how Big Nan and Little Nan hit him, how they took his family’s land, how they took his family’s money.
With this young guy taking the lead, no one was afraid anymore.
There were too many people who had been hit by Big Nan and Little Nan.
Everyone kept talking, from noon until sunset, and they still weren’t finished.
The people from the district recorded everything that was said, and then arrested Big Nan and Little Nan.
Gao Laohan and Sanhua also changed:
Sanhua, after being stared at and talked about in the district for so long, felt very embarrassed.
After returning home, she took a look at herself, and thought that the way she dressed was too ridiculous.
She then remembered that her daughter was about to get married, ..
.. and yet she was thinking about her own appearance and about hanging out with young guys.
It really shouldn’t be like that.
Hence, she decided to change her appearance from head to toe so that she looked more like someone’s mother.
She even put away the big red flower she had been using for the past thirty years to dress up as a god.
That day Gao Laohan returned from the district, ..
.. and again began telling his wife how Little Erhei and Duoxi’s birthdays were not suitable for marriage.
His wife said, “Put your fortune-telling book away!
Didn’t you say that Erhei was going to get in big trouble this time? What happened?
You turn to fortune-telling for every matter, with what outcome? You don’t remember the “not suitable for farming” joke?
I think Duoxi is great; just let her and our Erhei get married!”
Gao Laohan saw that even his own wife did not believe in his fortune-teling.
After that, he was embarrassed to take out his fortune-telling book and tell fortunes for other people.
After Duoxi and Little Erhei came home and saw that their parents all agreed for them to get married, they were very happy.
The two families took some time to prepare, and soon after, Duoxi and Little Erhei were married.
Everyone in the village would say that they were the best couple in the village!
